epics.title: codebase consistency sweep
epics.description: Fix formatting violations and consolidate structural duplication identified in the May 2026 consistency analysis.
epics.notes: Findings from rt analyze list-smells + find-duplicates sweep on 2026-05-11.

userStories.title: fix formatting violations: CRLF and encoding errors in 4 files
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want all source files to pass dotnet format so that CI and editor tooling agree on line endings and encoding.
acceptanceCriteria: ControlFlowUnwinder.cs, ConsumerNarrowerService.cs, InterfaceAnalyzerService.cs use project-standard encoding (no BOM)
userStories.notes: P1. Run dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx to auto-fix. Affected: src/RoslynTools/Services/TransformParametersService.cs (CRLF lines 13-14), src/RoslynTools/Core/ControlFlowUnwinder.cs, src/RoslynTools/Services/ConsumerNarrowerService.cs, src/RoslynTools/Services/InterfaceAnalyzerService.cs (encoding).

userStories.title: standardise --solution option construction via CommandOptionFactory across all commands
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want every command to use CommandOptionFactory.CreateSolutionOption() so that the solution option is consistent across commands.
acceptanceCriteria: No command Build() method contains a raw new Option<string?>("--solution", ...) construction
rt dump-help output descriptions are unchanged
userStories.notes: P2. Bypassing factory: AddDependencyCommand, DependencyGraphCommand, ExtractInterfaceCommand, FindDuplicatesCommand, FindMagicStringsCommand, FindPatternCommand, ListSmellsCommand, MakeAsyncCommand, MoveMethodCommand, TransformParametersCommand. Groups GRP-20/26/36/57 from find-duplicates.

userStories.title: remove duplicate FindDocumentId — use SymbolDocumentLocator.FindDocumentId from both callers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single FindDocumentId implementation so both callers use the same logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Behaviour is identical: returns null when symbol has no in-source location
userStories.notes: P2. Duplication: src/RoslynTools/Core/RoslynSyntax.cs:41 vs src/RoslynTools/Services/ConvertToRecordService.cs:84. find-duplicates GRP-4-18336c84.

userStories.title: extract shared IsGeneratedOrIntermediate helper from ImportDirectiveService and MagicStringService
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one IsGeneratedOrIntermediate check so both services apply the same filter.
acceptanceCriteria: A single IsGeneratedOrIntermediate method exists in a shared location (e.g. RoslynSyntax or FilePathFilters)
ImportDirectiveService and MagicStringService both delegate to it

userStories.title: extract shared BuildInterfaceText from ExtractInterfaceService and InterfaceAnalyzerService
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one BuildInterfaceText implementation so both services generate interface text consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: BuildInterfaceText exists in a single shared location
Both private copies in ExtractInterfaceService and InterfaceAnalyzerService are removed

userStories.title: extract shared BuildPreview helper from PatternMatcher and FindDuplicatesService
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one BuildPreview implementation so preview text is generated consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: BuildPreview exists in a single shared location
PatternMatcher and FindDuplicatesService both delegate to it
